Allowed product files are package.json and package-lock.json only. Any additional product/runtime/workflow file change is a scope breach.
Ordinary movement of origin/main is not a stop. Refresh against live main and classify only affected facts. Never require an old exact main SHA merely because it appeared in prior evidence.
Do not rebase, force-push, rewrite history, close PRs, mark ready, merge, mutate branch protection, or alter repository settings.

Repair existing PR #1113 in place only if its remote head can be updated without force-push or unrelated history surgery. If that is not possible, stop with NEEDS_SUPERVISOR_RECREATE instead of silently opening a replacement PR.

The current-main direct Next.js version controls applicability: if current main is already at 15.5.21 or a later accepted 15.5.x patch, prove containment and stop as ALREADY_CONTAINED_CANDIDATE; if current main has changed major/minor, stop for bounded JS-lane re-adjudication.

No secrets, credentials, tokens, cookies, private keys, .env values, or sensitive provider output may enter commits, proof, logs, or chat output.

steps.task: Regenerate the root manifest/lock deterministically for next@15.5.21 and prove there is no unrelated dependency churn.
requirements: Capture Node and npm versions.
Regenerate the package lock from the refreshed base with next pinned exactly to 15.5.21.
Do not update eslint-config-next or any other direct dependency.
Compare package-lock package records against origin/main. Changed package keys may only be the root record, node_modules/next, and node_modules/@next/*.
If npm resolution changes any unrelated package record, stop BLOCKED_UNRELATED_LOCK_CHURN.
commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
base=json.loads(Path('/tmp/TP-DMX-DEP-JS-SAFETY-W1A-1113-001-main-lock.json').read_text())
cand=json.loads(Path('package-lock.json').read_text())
bp=base.get('packages',{})
cp=cand.get('packages',{})
keys=sorted(set(bp)|set(cp))
changed=[k for k in keys if bp.get(k)!=cp.get(k)]
allowed=[k for k in changed if k=='' or k=='node_modules/next' or k.startswith('node_modules/@next/')]
print('CHANGED_PACKAGE_KEYS=', changed)
if changed != allowed:
    print('UNRELATED_PACKAGE_KEYS=', sorted(set(changed)-set(allowed)))
    raise SystemExit(1)
PY
